Name: Leah's Less Ugly House
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][b][i][u]Leah's Less Ugly House[/u][/i][/b][/size]

[size=3]A very simple mod with an unusually long description. [/size]

[size=3]Back from the dead with your daily dose of plant overload, todays protagonist is our lovable cottage gal, Leah!
Yes she forages most of her food out in the wild or go to the Saloon for dinner, but it's hard to sleep at night not knowing how she stores her forages to avoid it getting overrun with bugs and worms. Bleh.
[/size]
[size=3]I just add a teeny kitchen to for me to sleep soundly, and a few bits and bobs for cottage-core vibes. Ie some leaves circling the fireplace, a brick floor under it to avoid fires, and small others. [/size]

[size=3]Is it realistic? Probably not[/size]
[size=3]Do I care? No not really :p[/size]

[b][size=4]Why do I see that wallpaper so much?[/size][/b]
[size=3]I like it. Moving on..[/size]

[size=3][b]What are those black and white blobs by Leah's couch?
[/b]That's SmolHoomans [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10134]Domestic Pets[/url] mod, I couldn't be bothered to remove it mid screenshot so you know.. just imagine it's not there :p[/size]

[size=4][b]Is the couch (In the [u][color=#a4c2f4]Original[/color][/u] version) sittable?
[/b][/size][size=3]That's a funny question. Next!

[/size][size=4][b]Why did the requirements increase?
[/b][/size][size=3]I've been enjoying editing interiors a lot. And because I enjoy it, I learn more things veeeeery slowly.
Learning=I know more stuff
I know more stuff= I want to do more stuff
I want to do more stuff= other framework mods give me more opportunity.
Mods that give me more opportunity= I will be taking it, thank you[/size]

[i][u][color=#ea9999][size=5]NEW!! 1.0.4[/size][/color]

[/u][/i][list]
[*][size=3]Added an [u][b][color=#a4c2f4]Optional[/color][/b][/u] version - Check pictures for a preview, removed the couch to make it custom cutscene friendly + it's 99% recolor friendly. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM![/url][/size]
[/list]
[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b]AFTER[/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size][size=5]

[b][u][color=#ff0000][i]Very Important, Read me![/i][/color][/u][/b][/size]

[size=5]What this mod [/size][i][b][u][color=#ff0000][size=5]DOESN'T[/size][/color][/u] [/b][/i][size=5]do:[/size]

[size=4][b]1. Gives sittable couches[/b]
[/size]
[size=3]Bippity boppity the couch has no functionality.[/size]
[size=1](I know there's a way to make is so they're functional, but honestly not feeling that sort of work yet, maybe in the future :p)[/size]

[size=4][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]
[/size][size=3]
I made this mod with the VANILLA heart events in mind. [s]So in theory, it should work fine [b]without[/b] any mods that expands on Leah's story, changes it's interiors, or adds any cutscenes inside their home.

[b]Now, in relation to that I am not sure how well this mod works with a big expansion.[/b][/s]

As of Update 1.0.3, the [b][u][color=#a4c2f4]Optional[/color][/u][/b] version should work fine with custom cutscenes and whatnot.

[/size][size=4][b]3. Hello
[/b][/size][size=3]Hi
[/size]

[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]read above :)[/size]
[u][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=3]a b c d... you know what's next right? [/size]
[b][color=#00ff00][size=4][u]Leah [/u][u]Expansions[/u][/size][/color][/b][size=4], [/size][size=3]should be alright. Use the [u][b][color=#a4c2f4]Optional[/color][/b][/u] version if you have any issues.[/size]

[u][size=5][b][i]Installation[/i][/b]
[/size][/u][size=3]
1. Install Content Patcher and Extra Map Layers (EML for Android if you're on mobile!)
2. Download this mod
3. Extract the zip into your mods folder 
4. Viola![/size][/font]
